arms.fitpack_smooth: stored FITPACK count-weighted smoothing spline (p2.build 'smooth'), mf.manifold_coords shift walk
arms.interp_causalab_lam0: causalab SplineManifold periodic cubic smoothness 0 on the raw kept centroids at the stored coordinates (the endpoint arm 'causalab_interp' / interp_causalab_lam0 of p2_endpoint_diagnosis.json)
arms.causalab_lam_cv: causalab Reinsch smoother, lambda by leave-block-out on kept knots (exploratory)
arms.<arm>@chord_norm: that arm's PCA delta rescaled per clip and per waypoint to the chord's ||delta||

keys.walk: t_k = ta + s_k * curve.step(ta, tb), s = linspace(0,1,K), z_k = z + f(t_k) - f(ta) (src/wm/manifold.py manifold_coords, mode='shift'); residual kept (run_part2.compose); all spline arms use the stored curve's coordinates and step, so they traverse the same arc
keys.radius: |ProbeReadout.raw(W)|, norm of the ridge probe's (sin, cos) output (scripts/run_part2.py evaluate, wp_radius); probe fit on probe folds
keys.radius_min: per clip: min radius over the K waypoints; aggregated mean over clips per arc, then mean over arcs
keys.radius_mean: per clip: mean radius over the K waypoints (waypoint 0 = the unsteered clip included)
keys.monotone_frac: per clip: fraction of the K-1 consecutive steps in which the probe's decoded angle advances along the traversed arc (signed, unwrapped)
keys.ordering_spearman: per clip: Spearman(waypoint index, signed decoded progress)
keys.R_end_test: nearest-real R at the endpoint vs the mean of TEST clips at the target (run_part2.evaluate's nearest_real_R; comparable to stored nearest_real_R)
keys.R_wp_mean: per clip: mean over waypoints of nearest-real R vs the PROBE-FOLD full-space centroid at the waypoint's intended angle (src + s_k * traversed shift, snapped to nearest probe-fold value)
keys.ci95: 95% clip-bootstrap: clips resampled (all of a clip's targets together) within each arc, 1000 draws, statistic = mean over the 16 arcs of per-arc means
keys.paired_diff: arm - chord_raw computed per row, same bootstrap
keys.points: 12 = layer 12 (unsupervised angle), 22 = layer 22 (label angle), as run_endpoint_diagnosis 'auto'
keys.headline_arc: layer 12, seed 0 (held-out 303.75..343.125), the arc of p2_conceptor_direction_L12.json
